evidence: Procedure per quality-checks.md row 3: spell-check, placeholder grep, foreign-path/author-aside scan, duplicate-paragraph and contradiction review. (1) Spelling: extracted every distinct word from instruction.md, hireops_rules.md and integration.md and reviewed them by hand. No misspellings. Proper names (Costa, Sorensen, Okafor, Halvorsen, Haddad, Varga, Fischer, Nair) and terms (sqlite, cdn, better-sqlite3) are correct. Mixed spelling varieties: instruction.md:13 uses British 'honour (PORT)' and 'honouring DB_PATH', while hireops_rules.md:200 has 'Honor' and integration.md:7 has 'honoring'. Both spellings are valid, so this is not a 'real spelling error'. (2) Contamination: case-insensitive grep over all three files for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|placeholder|TBD|lorem|C:\|/Users/|/home/|F:/|turing|harbor|judge|rubric|criteri|reward|score|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|NOTE:|[[|{{ returned no hits. The template placeholder 'CHANGE_ME' (template instruction.md:1) has been fully replaced. All three files are pure ASCII, with no CR line endings, no trailing whitespace and no duplicated paragraphs. The only absolute paths are task-contract paths (/app, /app/server.js, /app/app.db, /assets/seed_data.json, /instructions/hireops_rules.md, /instructions/integration.md, /api/health), all intentional. No author asides. (3) Contradictions, cross-checked: accounts in instruction.md:17 (3 recruiters, 3 hiring managers, 1 observer, 3 candidates, password Hireops!2026) exactly match seed_data.json users and roles and hireops_rules.md:11. Port 3000 with PORT honoured (instruction.md:13) is consistent with integration.md:5 and hireops_rules.md:201. DB at /app/app.db honouring DB_PATH appears at instruction.md:13 and integration.md:7. Health 'never touches the database' (instruction.md:13) does not conflict with integration.md:9-10. Seed path /assets/seed_data.json is the same in all three files, and the seed contents listed in instruction.md:15 match hireops_rules.md:205-208 and the seed keys. The 15-second refresh (instruction.md:5) matches hireops_rules.md:117. 'Interview has a limited number of places per job' (instruction.md:3) matches hireops_rules.md:61-65. Draft persistence and isolation (instruction.md:7) match hireops_rules.md:170-175. Candidate visibility (instruction.md:9) matches hireops_rules.md:191-193. Undo 'as long as nobody has touched those cards since' (instruction.md:3) is refined, not contradicted, by hireops_rules.md:98-100 ('Adding a note does not count as a change'). The colloquial brief defers explicitly to the rules file at instruction.md:11. No two clocks, account lists or seed paths. Broken-app/alternative probe: this row grades the text of the brief, not app behaviour. I found no wording that a conforming app could violate through ambiguity introduced by a typo or contamination. Minor non-defect note: hireops_rules.md lines 99, 112 and 173 are much longer than the ~105-column wrap used elsewhere, which suggests sentences were appended during editing ('...Adding a note does not count as a change. A move can be undone once;...', '...A rejection line includes its reason. The Activity view lists them newest first...', '...it asks them to sign in again, and after signing in as the same person the reply is where they left it...'). They are grammatical, render identically as Markdown and contradict nothing, so this is cosmetic only. Deterministic check-instruction-hygiene/-content was not run by me; it belongs to the separate deterministic reviewer. My manual grep found no placeholder or rubric vocabulary.
